title: Greenacre Landscapes | Garden Design & Landscaping, Cheshire
desc: Garden design and landscaping across Cheshire. Patios, driveways, fencing, turfing and full garden transformations. Free site visit and 3D design.
h1: A garden you actually go outside for.
sub: Design-and-build landscaping across Cheshire. Patios, planting, fencing, lawns and full transformations — drawn up properly, priced fixed, and finished when we said we would finish.
svc_l: Design and build under one roof, so nobody can blame anybody else. Fixed price, fixed dates, staged payments.

services.title: Patios & paving
services.desc: Indian sandstone, porcelain and block paving, laid on a full mortar bed so it is still flat in ten years.

services.title: Garden design
services.desc: Measured survey and a 3D visual so you can see it before you commit. Free if we build it.

services.title: Fencing & screening
services.desc: Close board, feather edge, slatted screens and sleeper walls. Concrete posts as standard.

services.title: Turfing & lawn care
services.desc: New lawns laid on properly prepared ground, plus scarifying, feeding and seasonal maintenance.

services.title: Driveways
services.desc: Block paved and resin bound driveways with correct drainage and SUDS compliance.

services.title: Planting schemes
services.desc: Borders planned for year-round interest and your actual soil, not a garden centre trolley dash.

about_h: We design it, we build it, we stand behind it.
about_p: Greenacre is a five-person team working across Cheshire and the Wirral. We do not subcontract — the people who draw your garden are the people who build it. Every job gets a fixed price, a start date and an end date in writing, and we do not ask for money up front. You pay in stages as the work goes in.

reviews.quote: They turned a sloping, waterlogged mess into three usable terraces. The drainage work alone was worth it — no standing water through two winters since.
reviews.name: Helen Braithwaite

reviews.quote: The 3D design sold it to my husband. It looked exactly like the drawing when they finished, which apparently is not normal.
reviews.name: Gemma Price

reviews.quote: Fixed price, fixed dates, and they hit both. Cleared up every single evening. The neighbours have booked them too.
reviews.name: Alan Forsyth

faq.q: Do you charge for the design?
faq.a: A measured survey and 3D design is £450, and we take it straight off the build cost if you go ahead with us. If you do not, the drawings are yours to keep.

faq.q: When is the best time to start?
faq.a: We landscape all year. Hard landscaping — patios, walls, fencing — is fine through winter. Turf and planting are best spring or autumn.

faq.q: Do you need paying up front?
faq.a: No. You pay in stages as work is completed, with nothing due until the first stage is finished.
